method: Camera-matrix reprojection of previous linear HDR scene with bilinear sampling. Error is mean RGB absolute difference after Reinhard compression. One pose pair; this is an aliasing diagnostic, not a general perceptual metric.

regions.hairEdge: 30<y<270 and(x<210 or x>300), valid reprojected pixels

remainingLimitations: MSAA improves geometry coverage; translucent texture filtering and renderable-order changes can still shimmer.
BLEND material modes and original GLB files were preserved.
Background picker interaction was code reviewed; no separate native desktop picker automation.
